title: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
description:
Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story is a standalone 1–2 hour DLC that expands on the events of This Bed We Made. Playing the main game first is recommended, but optional.

 

We are now in 1964. Sophie has taken a new posting aboard the Orpheus, a transatlantic ship, a few years after the events at the Clarington Hotel. What was meant to be a fresh start is disrupted when colleagues and passengers begin reporting missing personal belongings…

Set entirely indoors within a small section of the ship, Lost & Found builds on the investigative gameplay of This Bed We Made through an intimate, self-contained narrative experience. Everyday tasks once again become part of the investigation, bringing back more of the cleaning and snooping players wanted more of!

Gameplay(IN)DISCREET INQUIRYA focused narrative mystery set aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship, where small details carry unexpected weight. 

BACK TO WORKMake the beds, tidy up, and tend to each cabin… where small details rarely stay hidden.

PRIVATE QUARTERSSnoop through cabins and shared spaces, inspecting personal items in 360° to uncover hidden details.

CABIN CONFESSIONSConverse with colleagues and passengers as secrets surface in unexpected ways.
description_short: Lost & Found is a standalone, short story game taking place aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship. Play as Sophie Roy in her new job as a stewardess, and help solve a curious series of thefts in this narrative-driven mystery set after the events of This Bed We Made.
